keys.hint: A key is limited by its creator's current permissions; revoking takes effect immediately.
keys.form_hint: Pick only the scopes the integration needs.

keys.empty_description: Create a key to connect automation tools.

hooks.hint: Zapier, Make or n8n add a subscription here when a flow turns on and remove it when it turns off. Deleting one stops deliveries.
hooks.empty_description: Subscriptions appear here when an automation tool subscribes.
hooks.delete_description: Deliveries to this URL stop; the flow will not trigger until the tool subscribes again.
help.title: Connect with Zapier / Make / n8n
help.description: The public API works with REST hooks and polling.
help.step_key: Create an API key with the scopes you need.
help.step_base: Base URL: your ClickFix API origin +
help.step_idempotency: Send a unique Idempotency-Key header on every write and reuse it unchanged on retry.
help.step_signature: Verify hook requests with ClickFix-Webhook-Signature (HMAC-SHA256) and deduplicate by ClickFix-Webhook-Id.
help.polling: When polling, keep next_cursor and continue while has_more is true. History is kept for 30 days.
help.zapier: Map the endpoints above to a REST hook trigger's subscribe, unsubscribe and list.
help.make: A custom webhook module plus the same subscribe / unsubscribe requests as HTTP actions.
help.n8n: Use the HTTP Request node with the same endpoints, or package a community node from the n8n node definition.
